verdict.rationale: Channel3 is API-first. Its core capabilities are documented through the API, SDK, CLI and MCP surfaces: text, image and URL search, filters, structured product lookup, agentic search mode, price-tracking webhooks, affiliate attribution and keyless agent payment. That makes UI-only functionality unlikely. However, no source explicitly states UI/API parity, and probes found no published OpenAPI spec. Missing for 10: explicit parity statement or UI-vs-API feature mapping, API coverage of account/dashboard/billing management, machine-readable OpenAPI spec, independent hands-on confirmation of parity.
